question: How many percent of LAM customer consumed more than 46.73?
evidence: Percentage of LAM customer consumed more than 46.73 = (Total no. of LAM customers who consumed more than 46.73 / Total no. of LAM customers) * 100.
clarification: Also keep rows that have no matching yearmonth record.
gold: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(T2.Consumption > 46.73, 1, 0)) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.CustomerID) FROM customers AS T1 LEFT JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T1.Segment = 'LAM'
gold0: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(T2.Consumption > 46.73, 1, 0)) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(T1.CustomerID) FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T1.Segment = 'LAM'

d.request: What percentage of LAM customers consumed more than 46.73, calculated as (the number of LAM customers who consumed more than 46.73 / the total number of LAM customers) * 100, while also keeping LAM customers that have no matching yearmonth record?
d.sql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN y.Consumption > 46.73 THEN c.CustomerID END) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerID) AS percentage FROM customers c LEFT JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM'

b.request: Percentage of customers in the LAM segment (all of them, including those with no yearmonth records, which count in the denominator but not as consuming more than 46.73) whose Consumption in yearmonth is greater than 46.73, computed as (number of LAM customers with Consumption > 46.73 / total number of LAM customers)
b.sql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM yearmonth y WHERE y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID AND y.Consumption > 46.73) THEN c.CustomerID END) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerID) AS percentage FROM customers c WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM'
